scope: Public deployment browser flows: graph switching, source-byte verified context, bounded export, hosted coding inference, local uploads, tampering, source changes, expired/withdrawn reviews, provider outage recovery, current re-evaluation, mobile/theme, migration, read-only API, launch video playback and downloads. Controlled outage responses are browser-local test simulations.

two_client_regression_scope: Two browser tests use locally signed synthetic fixtures and intercepted responses to exercise state transitions and provider failure. They are regression tests, not chain proof.
navigation_regression_scope: Four additional browser checks cover graph-profile sharing/reload/Back, keyboard skip/focus and shareable views, mobile selected context to the matching AI example, and historical withdrawal proof versus fresh reads. They use the deployed UI and read-only hosted data.
